description: Step-by-step lessons that pause play while a player learns. The mechanism (steps, highlighting, pausing, progress kept on the device) is here; what the lessons say and which element each step rings stay with the application.

lessons.lessons: list of {id (lower-case letters, digits, hyphens), screen? (the screen it belongs to), steps: [{title, text, anchor}]}; title and text are translation keys, anchor names the element to ring (data-guide on the web, tourAnchor on Apple and Android)

storage: progress is one key per lesson (prefix + lesson id, default 'tut.<id>' = '1') and one key for whether the person wants to be guided (default 'beginner': true or false, anything else means not yet asked); the keys are options so an application keeps its own

Tour.want.returns: boolean (queued; false if unknown, not guided, already seen or already waiting)

Tour.next.returns: void (on the last step the lesson ends and is remembered)

Tour.skip.returns: void (ends the lesson on show for good)

Tour.screenChanged.returns: void (drops lessons that belong to another screen, even the one showing, without marking them seen)

Tour.reset.returns: void (every lesson shows again; guidance on)

Tour.holding.returns: boolean (true while a lesson is open: hold play for everyone)

requires.controls: panel and button builders for the card (web), Panel and theme (Apple, Android)
requires.preferences: where the device's choice to be guided belongs; pass the same storage and keys to the tour, or set it through the tour
requires.language: the translation lookup behind `translate` (the language component's lookup over the current messages)
